prompt: A cel-shaded comic-book video game render: 3D figures and buildings covered in thick hand-inked black contours and rough crosshatching, textures painted by hand with visible brush marks, flat bold colour. A tall narrow city building cut open in cross-section like a doll's house after dark, four floors only, seen from across the street, low and to the left, so the building stands off-centre and the street runs out of frame. Attic: an old woman in a coat shivers by one candle in an ice blue room. Street level: a brick red bakery; a red crowd and a blue crowd of mixed ages and skin tones shove each other under a yellow street lamp, the roof of a police vehicle in the near left corner. Basement: in emerald lamplight, printing presses throw banknotes into the air while gangsters in pinstripe suits play music and a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat and gold chain dances. Bottom: an orange furnace. Soot, peeling paint and puddles. Thanks.
